quote1.text: There's always some crazy guy who puts 1000M on Pogačar. Personally, I focus on Asian races.
quote1.author: Bubu

quote2.text: For me, it's Landa, Pedersen, and Schmid – I've got my guys. No one dares touch them. And I've had quite a bit of success too.
quote2.author: Matt B

quote3.text: I built a historic roster with my former sponsor Sirop Sport. Got mocked a lot, but some riders emerged later, like Louis Barré!
quote3.author: Lucas M.
